<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Imperial Code Cylinder.

'''Card text:''' Use when an Imperial leader is at a location with a Scomp link. Choose one: (1) Look at either Reserve Deck for 20 seconds, then reshuffle it. (2) If also at a Death Star location, cancel [[Scomp Link Access]] and [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]].

'''Lore:''' Imperial officers are issued code cylinders for using Scomp links. Each cylinder is set to its owner's security level, determining what information can be retrieved.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese specifies a location and a Death Star location; the English specifies presence with a Scomp link and a Death Star site. The Japanese lists the two cards to cancel without an explicit “or”; the English says to cancel one or the other. The Japanese says to reshuffle the Reserve Deck; the English says to shuffle, cut and replace it.
